lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 2 fix 002: address reviewer finding

nextStoryContext: Round 2 reviewer finding at scripts/build-release.sh:114 (SECTION 5b-equivalent of scripts/cam/review-artifact.txt): after US-001 removed the ~/.config/cam/config.toml write, nothing in src/ reads CAM_CONFIG_PATH any more (grep -rln CAM_CONFIG_PATH over src/ index.ts returns nothing), but 3 files still set/documented the now-dead var -- the same stale-cross-reference class round 1 already fixed for docs/ (US-R1-001) and for the vestigial env plumbing inside test/init.test.ts (US-R1-003). Swept all 3: (1) scripts/build-release.sh:114 dropped the `CAM_CONFIG_PATH="${SMOKE_DIR}/config.toml"` prefix from the hermetic init smoke invocation (also trimmed the 'and a tmp config' clause from the preceding comment block); (2) test/interactivity/interactivity.test.ts:502-517 dropped the save/set/restore of process.env.CAM_CONFIG_PATH around the runInit() gate test -- and since that also made the mkdtempSync'd tmpWorkDir pointless (it was only ever used to build the redirected config path, never as a cwd or passed to runInit()), removed the now-fully-vestigial tmpdir create/cleanup too rather than leaving a create-then-delete-nothing artifact; (3) test/build-release-smoke.test.ts:32 updated the doc-comment example line that showed the old CAM_CONFIG_PATH=... shape to match the new invocation. Verified via binInitInvocations() in test/build-release-smoke.test.ts (matches only the `}" init` shape, never asserted the env-var string) that dropping the var breaks nothing, and confirmed by grep that no live src/ or test/ code references CAM_CONFIG_PATH any more (only test/init.test.ts's own explanatory prose, describing the historical removal, and the immutable scripts/cam/journal.archive.md still mention the name -- both expected, neither live plumbing). All quality gates green: typecheck 0 errors, full `bun test` 5760/5760 pass, full `bun run check:all` spine (test/embed-vendor/lint/file-size/debt-markers/version-skips/coverage/dead-code/dup/ci-parity/agents-md/test-sleeps/skip-ratchet) all ok.
